bio.text: Kimberly Daniels is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 14.
According to the House's biographical page, Daniels served in the House from 2016 to 2020 and was elected again in 2022.

Daniels lives in Jacksonville, where Daniels was born, is an author and international speaker, and lists a bachelor's degree in criminology from Florida State University along with an M.A. in Christian education and a D.C.C. in Christian counseling.
